caption: Figure 13-2. The frozen pseudo-labelled dataset version
alt: The Dataset version document of dataset/fleurs-sr-pseudo: state frozen, hours and splits, the leakage result, the quality checks and the shards.

regions.label: Frozen
regions.note: The freeze copied the audio into the content store once and fixed the content: from here a run may train on it, and nothing changes it.

regions.label: Leakage
regions.target: [data-panel='dataset-version'] >> text=Leakage: checked when it was frozen
regions.note: Checked against all 35 golden sets by audio hash and by the hash of the source file, so a re-cut golden recording is caught too.

regions.label: Splits
regions.note: Speaker-disjoint: no speaker is in two splits. FLEURS publishes no speaker ids, so each file counts as its own speaker here.

regions.label: Quality checks
regions.note: Silence, clipping and transcripts too long or short for their audio. A failed check does not block the freeze; it tells you what to look at.

regions.label: Adopt
regions.note: Next step: adopting writes the version into data.lock, the project's record of which data its pipelines may read.
